hero.headline: Licensed electricians in {city}
hero.subhead: Panels, wiring and repairs done to code by licensed electricians. Call and hear the price before any work starts.

fear.answer: Every job is done by a licensed electrician, with a permit where one is required.

services.name: Panel upgrades
services.summary: Old or full panels replaced, sized for what you run today.
services.whenNeeded: Breakers trip often, the panel is full, or you're adding an EV charger.
services.differentiator: Permit and inspection handled for you.

services.name: EV chargers
services.summary: Level 2 home chargers installed and permitted.
services.whenNeeded: You bought or ordered an electric vehicle.

services.name: Wiring and repairs
services.summary: Dead outlets, flickering lights and faulty wiring, found and fixed.
services.whenNeeded: Something sparks, buzzes, flickers or stopped working.

services.name: Renovation wiring
services.summary: Wiring for basements, kitchens and additions, to code.
services.whenNeeded: You're renovating and need wiring that passes inspection.
services.differentiator: We work to your contractor's schedule.
